summary: Marc Berman carries California Jewish Democrats' strongest-tier Strong Support endorsement from the organization formerly called Democrats for Israel California, a Zionist group. Per CalMatters, he recorded an Aye on AB 715, a bill establishing a state antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight mechanism. These are the two principal documented actions in his record bearing on Palestinian justice, and both point to the pro-Israel end of the spectrum.
